ini_comment: Building placement rules and tiberium behavior
comment: Building placement rules and tiberium behavior.

rules.name: PreventBuildingInShroud
rules.comment: Prevent a player from placing a building inside the shroud/fog of war.

rules.name: AllowBuildingBesideWalls
rules.comment: Allow building structures off player walls. Default is OFF since to balance ModernWallBuilding.

rules.name: TiberiumGrows
rules.comment: Tiberium cells will grow on the map.

rules.name: TiberiumSpreads
rules.comment: Tiberium will spread to nearby cells.

rules.name: SlowTiberiumGrowthAndSpread
rules.comment: Slows down tiberium spread and growth (half the default rate)

rules.name: TiberiumGrowthRate
rules.comment: Controls the rate of tiberium growth, note enabling `SlowTiberiumGrowthAndSpread` will half the set rate. _Note: excessive values may cause performance problems._

rules.name: TiberiumSpreadRate
rules.comment: Controls the rate of tiberium spread, note enabling `SlowTiberiumGrowthAndSpread` will half the set rate. _Note: excessive values may cause performance problems._

rules.name: TiberiumInfantryDamage
rules.comment: The amount of damage infantry takes by walking across a cell of tiberium, if infantry type has the `ImmuneToTiberium` flag is set to `yes` then this is ignored for that type.

rules.name: TiberiumBlossomTreeDamage
rules.comment: The amount of damage nearby units/infantry etc. take by when a blossom tree shoots tiberium in the air.
